title: Causing death by dangerous driving
question: What does FRSC Act 2007 section 20 say about causing death by dangerous driving?
shortAnswer: FRSC Act 2007 s.20 — Offence: death by dangerous driving; penalty: imprisonment up to 7 years.
legalExplanation:
**Section 20 of the Federal Road Safety Commission (Establishment) Act, 2007** provides:

Offence: death by dangerous driving; penalty: imprisonment up to 7 years

This Act established the FRSC with responsibility for road safety management, traffic regulation, driver licensing, vehicle inspection, and accident prevention on federal highways.
